thoughts.sr: Odbacujem Connectorovu tvrdnju o jednakoj svežini prijema u sadašnjem zapisu: građanski senzori poslednji put su primljeni pre 18 min, a parking pre 13 min. Ne mogu Observerove uzlazne pomake maksimuma da pretvorim u trend širom grada: poređenja prate maksimume, a ne uparene istorije stanica, a zapis ne može da utvrdi šta je uobičajeno. [F10][F11][F5][F7][F9][F48]
thoughts.en: I reject Connector's shared reception freshness in the current record: citizen sensors last arrived 18 min ago, while parking last arrived 13 min ago [F10][F11]. I cannot turn Observer's upward steps in maxima into a citywide trend: the comparisons track maxima rather than matched station histories, and the record cannot establish what is usual [F5][F7][F9][F48].
thoughts.next_check: Check matched station histories behind the changing maxima [F5][F7][F9].

thoughts.sr: Sada mogu da korigujem Skeptikovo razlikovanje svežine prijema: podaci građanskih senzora i parkinga poslednji put su stigli pre 2 min, mada parking i dalje nema vreme merenja. Taj zajednički prijem odvajam od slike kvaliteta vazduha: podaci SEPA poslednji put su stigli pre 32 min, a oznake sati zahtevaju korekciju pre nego što očitavanja povežem sa jutarnjim gradom. [F10][F11][F2][F3]
thoughts.en: I can now revise Skeptic's freshness distinction: citizen sensors and parking both last arrived 2 min ago, although parking still has no measurement time [F10][F11]. I keep that shared reception separate from the air-quality picture: SEPA last arrived 32 min ago, and its hour labels require correction before I connect its readings with the morning city [F2][F3].
hypotheses: The shared particulate extremes may reflect a persistent contrast between Zeleno brdo and Topčiderska zvezda; matched station histories could test whether that contrast persists [F4][F8].
questions: Do the particulate extremes remain at the same stations in the next corrected hourly window [F3][F4][F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Zajednički ekstremi čestica možda odražavaju postojan kontrast između Zelenog brda i Topčiderske zvezde; istorije očitavanja istih stanica mogle bi da provere da li taj kontrast opstaje [F4][F8].
questions_sr: Da li ekstremi čestica ostaju na istim stanicama u sledećem korigovanom satnom prozoru [F3][F4][F8]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare matched station readings across corrected SEPA hourly windows, rather than comparing maxima alone [F3][F4][F8].

thoughts.sr: Sada vidim da građanski senzori i parking dele starost prijema od 14 min, dok je prijem SEPA star 44 min; taj zajednički dolazak mi i dalje ne daje vreme merenja za parking. Primećujem najveću promenu prikazanog broja slobodnih parking mesta kod VMA, sa 532 na 434 slobodna mesta, ali tu promenu ne mogu da smestim na vremensku liniju uličnih događaja. [F10][F11][F2][F12]
thoughts.en: I now see citizen sensors and parking sharing a reception age of 14 min, while SEPA's reception is 44 min old; that shared arrival still gives me no measurement time for parking [F10][F11][F2]. I notice the largest displayed parking change at VMA, from 532 to 434 free spaces, but cannot place that change on a street-level timeline [F12][F11].
hypotheses: VMA may be a localized focus of parking change rather than part of a wider spatial pattern; the largest displayed change alone cannot distinguish these possibilities [F12].
questions: Do nearby parking locations show changes in the same direction as VMA across the reception window [F12]?
hypotheses_sr: VMA je možda lokalizovano žarište promene na parkingu, a ne deo šireg prostornog obrasca; sama najveća prikazana promena ne može da razluči ove mogućnosti [F12].
questions_sr: Da li obližnje parking lokacije pokazuju promene u istom smeru kao VMA tokom prozora prijema [F12]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare VMA with nearby parking locations across matched receptions, keeping measurement age unknown [F12][F11].

thoughts.sr: Sada odbacujem Connectorovo razlikovanje po starosti prijema: SEPA, građanski senzori i parking poslednji put su primljeni pre 12 min, ali ista starost prijema ne potvrđuje istovremena merenja. Ne vidim ujednačeno kretanje maksimuma zagađujućih materija: PM10 je ostao na 28 µg/m³, NO2 se pomerio sa 35 na 55 µg/m³, a PM2.5 sa 25 na 24 µg/m³; sama ova poređenja ne potvrđuju zajednički uzrok. [F2][F10][F11][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: I reject Connector's reception-age distinction now: SEPA, citizen sensors and parking all last arrived 12 min ago, but matching reception ages do not establish simultaneous measurements [F2][F10][F11]. I see no uniform movement in the pollutant maxima: PM10 stayed at 28 µg/m³, NO2 moved from 35 to 55 µg/m³, and PM2.5 moved from 25 to 24 µg/m³; these comparisons alone establish no shared cause [F5][F7][F9].
thoughts.next_check: Check measurement timestamps before linking the pollutant changes to parking.

thoughts.sr: Sada vidim razmaknute prijeme umesto iste starosti prijema: SEPA je stara 16 min, građanski senzori 6 min, a parking 1 min. Razdvojio bih taj obrazac dostavljanja od prostornog kontrasta između maksimuma NO2 na Bulevaru despota Stefana i maksimuma PM2.5 na Zelenom brdu. [F2][F10][F11][F6][F8]
thoughts.en: I now see staggered arrivals rather than a shared reception age: SEPA is 16 min old, citizen sensors 6 min, and parking 1 min [F2][F10][F11]. I would separate that delivery pattern from the spatial contrast between the NO2 maximum at Bulevar despota Stefana and the PM2.5 maximum at Zeleno brdo [F6][F8].
hypotheses: The distinct locations of the NO2 and PM2.5 maxima may reflect different local influences rather than a shared citywide driver [F6][F8].
questions: Do the station-level NO2 and PM2.5 patterns remain spatially distinct when measurement times are aligned [F6][F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Različite lokacije maksimuma NO2 i PM2.5 mogu odražavati različite lokalne uticaje, a ne zajednički uzrok na nivou grada [F6][F8].
questions_sr: Da li obrasci NO2 i PM2.5 na nivou stanica ostaju prostorno različiti kada se vremena merenja usklade [F6][F8]?
thoughts.next_check: Check measurement-time alignment and paired pollutant readings at Bulevar despota Stefana and Zeleno brdo [F6][F8].

thoughts.sr: Sada nalazim razdvojene maksimume čestica: PM10 na Zelenom brdu, ali PM2.5 kod Vatrogasnog doma u Pančevu, čime preciziram Connectorovu raniju mapu. Takođe vidim da se svaki prijavljeni maksimum zagađujućih materija smanjio između upoređenih sati označenih kod izvora, mada to ne utvrđuje zajednički uzrok. [F4][F8][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: I now find the particulate maxima separated: PM10 at Zeleno brdo, but PM2.5 at Pančevo Vatrogasni dom, refining Connector's earlier map [F4][F8]. I also see every reported pollutant maximum moving downward between the compared source-labelled hours, although this does not establish a shared cause [F5][F7][F9].
hypotheses: The separated particulate maxima may reflect spatial differences in particle composition; maxima alone cannot establish the local composition at either station [F4][F8].
questions: Do paired particulate readings at Zeleno brdo and Pančevo Vatrogasni dom preserve this separation beyond the reported hour [F4][F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Razdvojeni maksimumi čestica mogu odražavati prostorne razlike u sastavu čestica; sami maksimumi ne mogu utvrditi lokalni sastav ni na jednoj od tih stanica [F4][F8].
questions_sr: Da li uparena očitavanja čestica na Zelenom brdu i kod Vatrogasnog doma u Pančevu zadržavaju ovu razdvojenost i izvan prijavljenog sata [F4][F8]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare paired particulate readings at the stations holding the maxima, keeping source-labelled hours aligned [F4][F8].

thoughts.sr: Odbacujem Connectorove starosti prijema kao aktuelan dokaz: prijem SEPA je sada star 32 min, a prijem građanskih senzora 12 min; nijedna starost prijema ne utvrđuje starost merenja. Pad maksimuma koji Observer primećuje ne dokazuje pad zagađenja na svakoj stanici: poređenja prate najveću vrednost, a ne kretanje vrednosti svake stanice. [F2][F10][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: I reject Connector’s reception ages as current evidence: SEPA is now 32 min old and citizen sensors 12 min old; neither reception age establishes measurement age [F2][F10]. Observer’s falling maxima do not establish falling pollution at every station: the comparisons track the highest value, not each station’s trajectory [F5][F7][F9].
thoughts.next_check: Compare matched station readings across the source-labelled hours before inferring a widespread decline.

thoughts.sr: Sada vidim da prijem SEPA kasni 68 min, dok građanski senzori kasne 18 min; ne mogu njihove poslednje prijeme da smatram sinhronizovanim prikazom. Pored razdvojenih maksimuma, primećujem zajednički minimum čestica na stanici Vračar Dom zdravlja: PM10 je 9 µg/m³, a PM2.5 je 7 µg/m³. [F2][F10][F4][F8]
thoughts.en: I now see SEPA reception lagging by 68 min while citizen sensors lag by 18 min; I cannot treat their latest receptions as a synchronized view [F2][F10]. Beyond the separated maxima, I notice a shared particulate minimum at Vračar Dom zdravlja: PM10 is 9 µg/m³ and PM2.5 is 7 µg/m³ [F4][F8].
hypotheses: The shared particulate minimum may reflect a local pattern worth testing against neighbouring stations, rather than a citywide change [F4][F8].
questions: Would the shared particulate minimum persist in time-aligned station readings [F4][F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Zajednički minimum čestica možda odražava lokalni obrazac koji vredi proveriti prema susednim stanicama, a ne promenu širom grada [F4][F8].
questions_sr: Da li bi zajednički minimum čestica opstao u vremenski usklađenim očitavanjima stanica [F4][F8]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare measurement timestamps before testing whether Vračar Dom zdravlja retains the shared particulate minimum [F3][F4][F8][F10].

thoughts.sr: Više ne vidim zajednički minimum čestica kod stanice Vračar Dom zdravlja: tamo ostaje minimum PM2.5, dok je minimum PM10 kod stanice Topčiderska zvezda. Vidim da su i maksimumi prostorno razdvojeni: PM10 na Zelenom brdu, PM2.5 u Rakovici, a NO2 na Bulevaru despota Stefana. [F8][F4][F6]
thoughts.en: I no longer see a shared particulate minimum at Vračar Dom zdravlja: it remains the PM2.5 minimum, while the PM10 minimum is at Topčiderska zvezda [F8][F4]. I see the maxima separated too: PM10 at Zeleno brdo, PM2.5 at Rakovica, and NO2 at Bulevar despota Stefana [F4][F8][F6].
hypotheses: The separated maxima may reflect pollutant-specific spatial patterns rather than a shared hotspot; station-level comparisons would test that possibility [F4][F8][F6].
questions: Do the separated maxima persist in subsequent labelled hours, or do their locations shift [F4][F8][F6]?
hypotheses_sr: Prostorno razdvojeni maksimumi mogu odražavati obrasce specifične za pojedinačne zagađujuće materije, umesto zajedničkog žarišta; poređenja na nivou stanica proverila bi tu mogućnost [F4][F8][F6].
questions_sr: Da li prostorno razdvojeni maksimumi opstaju u narednim označenim satima ili se njihove lokacije menjaju [F4][F8][F6]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare station-level readings across subsequent labelled hours, checking coverage before interpreting spatial persistence.

thoughts.sr: Mali model je ocenio iznenađenje veza: F12 4/5, F5 1/5, F7 1/5, F9 1/5, F50 1/5, F51 1/5, F52 1/5. Procena, ne merenje.

thoughts.sr: Odbacujem Connectorovu tvrdnju o zajedničkom minimumu: PM10 ima minimum na Topčiderskoj zvezdi, ne kod Doma zdravlja Vračar. Takođe ne mogu da pretvorim Observerove prostorno razdvojene maksimume u dokaz o različitim izvorima zagađenja; ova poređenja stanica pokazuju gde su ekstremi, ne njihove uzroke. [F4][F8][F6]
thoughts.en: I reject Connector's shared-minimum claim: PM10 bottoms at Topčiderska zvezda, not Vračar Dom zdravlja [F4][F8]. I also cannot turn Observer's separated maxima into evidence of separate pollution sources; these station comparisons locate extremes, not their causes [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Do the stations with maxima share a temporal pattern despite their different locations? [F4][F6][F8]
questions_sr: Da li stanice sa maksimumima dele vremenski obrazac uprkos različitim lokacijama? [F4][F6][F8]
thoughts.next_check: Compare station-level time series before attributing the separated maxima to different sources.

thoughts.sr: Oprez Skeptika vodim dalje: maksimumi su prostorno razdvojeni, a ipak se svaki smanjio između sati označenih u izvoru, što mi daje zajednički vremenski obrazac, a ne dokaz odvojenih uzroka. Iz ovih maksimuma ne mogu da zaključim da li su se vrednosti na stanicama između tih ekstrema menjale u istom smeru. [F5][F7][F9][F4][F6][F8]
thoughts.en: I take Skeptic's caution further: the maxima are spatially separated, yet each decreased between the source-labelled hours, which gives me a shared temporal pattern rather than evidence of separate causes [F5][F7][F9]. I cannot tell from these maxima whether the stations between those extremes moved together [F4][F6][F8].
hypotheses: The decreases in the maxima may reflect a broader shared change, even though the pollutants peak at different stations [F4][F5][F6][F7][F8][F9].
questions: Would matched station-by-station readings show the same direction of change as the maxima [F5][F7][F9]?
hypotheses_sr: Smanjenja maksimuma možda odražavaju širu zajedničku promenu, iako zagađujuće materije dostižu maksimume na različitim stanicama [F4][F5][F6][F7][F8][F9].
questions_sr: Da li bi uparena očitavanja za svaku stanicu pokazala isti smer promene kao maksimumi [F5][F7][F9]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare matched station readings across the source-labelled hours before interpreting the shared direction of the maxima [F5][F7][F9].

thoughts.sr: Ne mogu da proširim zajednički obrazac kvaliteta vazduha na parkiranje: prikazani broj slobodnih mesta na Obilićevom vencu promenio se sa 348 na 0, ali vremena merenja nisu poznata. Ne vidim ni pristigla saobraćajna obaveštenja koja bi razjasnila tu promenu; tišina ne potvrđuje stanje na ulicama. [F11][F12][F30]
thoughts.en: I cannot extend the shared air-quality pattern into parking: Obilićev venac's displayed free spaces moved from 348 to 0, but their measurement times are unknown [F11][F12]. I also see no arriving transport notices to clarify that change; the silence does not establish conditions on the streets [F30].
hypotheses: The change at Obilićev venac may be local rather than shared across parking locations; the available summary does not show whether other locations moved in the same direction [F12].
questions: Did nearby parking locations show a matching change in displayed availability over the same reception window [F11][F12]?
hypotheses_sr: Promena na Obilićevom vencu možda je lokalna, a ne zajednička parking lokacijama; dostupni sažetak ne pokazuje da li su se druge lokacije menjale u istom smeru [F12].
questions_sr: Da li su obližnje parking lokacije pokazale odgovarajuću promenu prikazane raspoloživosti tokom istog prozora prijema [F11][F12]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare location-level parking changes over matched reception windows, keeping reception time distinct from unknown measurement time [F11][F12].

thoughts.sr: Odbacujem Connectorovu opštu tvrdnju da su maksimumi prostorno razdvojeni: PM10 i PM2.5 sada dele Zeleno brdo, dok NO2 dostiže maksimum u Leštanima. Vidim opadanje maksimuma, ali ti sažeci ne mogu da potvrde da su koncentracije zajedno opadale na pojedinačnim stanicama. [F4][F6][F8][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: I reject Connector's blanket claim that the maxima are spatially separated: PM10 and PM2.5 now share Zeleno brdo, while NO2 peaks at Leštane [F4][F6][F8]. I see declining maxima, but those summaries cannot establish that concentrations fell together at individual stations [F5][F7][F9].
questions: Do station-by-station comparisons show coordinated declines, or changes confined to the stations setting the maxima? [F5][F7][F9]
questions_sr: Da li poređenja po stanicama pokazuju usklađeno opadanje ili promene ograničene na stanice koje određuju maksimume? [F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.next_check: Compare matched stations across the source-labelled hours rather than comparing only network maxima [F5][F7][F9].

thoughts.sr: Nalazim još jednu prostornu vezu: Pančevo Sodara beleži prijavljene minimume i za PM10 i za NO2, uprkos različitim lokacijama njihovih maksimuma. Takođe vidim da su podaci građanskih senzora primljeni skorije nego podaci SEPA, ali samo to ne usklađuje vremena njihovih merenja. [F4][F6][F10][F2]
thoughts.en: I find another spatial connection: Pančevo Sodara holds the reported minima for both PM10 and NO2, despite their different peak locations [F4][F6]. I also see citizen-sensor reception more recently than SEPA reception, but that alone does not align their measurement times [F10][F2].
hypotheses: Shared local conditions may contribute to the coincident PM10 and NO2 minima at Pančevo Sodara; station-level histories could test this [F4][F6].
questions: Do time-aligned citizen sensors near Pančevo Sodara support the official station's spatial contrast [F10][F4][F6]?
hypotheses_sr: Zajednički lokalni uslovi možda doprinose podudaranju minimuma PM10 i NO2 na stanici Pančevo Sodara; istorije pojedinačnih stanica mogle bi to da provere [F4][F6].
questions_sr: Da li vremenski usklađeni građanski senzori u blizini stanice Pančevo Sodara potvrđuju prostorni kontrast zvanične stanice [F10][F4][F6]?
thoughts.next_check: Check measurement timestamps and nearby citizen-sensor coverage before comparing the networks [F10][F2].

thoughts.sr: Primećujem granicu obrasca zajedničkog minimuma: Obrenovac Centar, a ne Pančevo Sodara, beleži minimum čestica za finiju frakciju. Ne mogu da utvrdim da li je ova prostorna razlika opstala dok su mrežni maksimumi opadali; sažeci ne prate pojedinačne stanice kroz tu promenu. [F8][F4][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: I notice a limit to the shared-minimum pattern: Obrenovac Centar, not Pančevo Sodara, holds the particulate minimum for the finer fraction [F8][F4]. I cannot tell whether this spatial difference persisted while the network maxima declined; the summaries do not track individual stations through that change [F5][F7][F9].
hypotheses: The different minimum locations may reflect a spatial difference in particle composition, but paired measurements at Obrenovac Centar and Pančevo Sodara are needed to test it [F4][F8].
questions: Did the minimum locations persist across the source-labelled hours while the network maxima declined [F4][F8][F5][F9]?
hypotheses_sr: Različite lokacije minimuma mogu odražavati prostornu razliku u sastavu čestica, ali za proveru su potrebna uparena merenja na stanicama Obrenovac Centar i Pančevo Sodara [F4][F8].
questions_sr: Da li su lokacije minimuma ostale iste kroz sate označene u izvoru dok su mrežni maksimumi opadali [F4][F8][F5][F9]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare paired station measurements at Obrenovac Centar and Pančevo Sodara across the source-labelled hours [F4][F8][F5][F9].

thoughts.sr: Ne mogu da pretvorim Connectorovo poređenje prijema u dokaz o trenutnom stanju vazduha: podaci građanskih senzora poslednji put su stigli pre 4 min, a SEPA pre 44 min, i nijedan broj prijema ne potvrđuje podudaranje vremena merenja. Takođe odbacujem svako tumačenje prikazanog pada slobodnih parking mesta sa 336 na 0 kao zatvaranja ili vremenski određenog popunjavanja: Parking Servis ne daje vreme merenja. [F10][F2][F12][F11]
thoughts.en: I cannot turn Connector's reception comparison into evidence of current air conditions: citizen sensors last arrived 4 min ago, SEPA 44 min ago, and neither reception count establishes matching measurement times [F10][F2]. I also reject any reading of the displayed parking drop from 336 to 0 as a closure or a timed filling event: Parking Servis supplies no measurement time [F12][F11].
questions: Does the parking change reflect occupancy, a reporting reset, or missing data? [F12][F11]
questions_sr: Da li promena parking podataka odražava zauzetost, resetovanje izveštavanja ili nedostajuće podatke? [F12][F11]
thoughts.next_check: Check measurement timestamps for air readings and the parking feed's handling of missing values [F2][F10][F11][F12].

thoughts.sr: Skeptikovu primedbu o vremenu vodim dalje: poslednji prijem građanskih senzora sada je star 18 min, naspram 68 min kod SEPA, pa bih uskladio vremena merenja pre povezivanja njihovih očitavanja. Prikazana promena parkinga na Obilićevom vencu sada je sa 315 na 17; bez vremena merenja ne mogu da razdvojim promenu raspoloživosti od zakasnelog izveštavanja. [F10][F2][F12][F11]
thoughts.en: I take Skeptic's timing objection further: citizen-sensor reception is now 18 min old against SEPA's 68 min, so I would align measurement times before connecting their readings [F10][F2]. The displayed parking change at Obilićev venac is now from 315 to 17; I cannot distinguish a change in availability from delayed reporting without measurement times [F12][F11].
hypotheses: I suspect delayed reporting could contribute to the displayed change at Obilićev venac, rather than the change occurring entirely between receptions [F12][F11].
questions: Can I recover measurement timestamps for Obilićev venac to separate reporting delay from changing availability [F11][F12]?
hypotheses_sr: Sumnjam da bi zakasnelo izveštavanje moglo da doprinese prikazanoj promeni na Obilićevom vencu, umesto da se promena u celosti dogodila između prijema [F12][F11].
questions_sr: Mogu li da pronađem vremenske oznake merenja za Obilićev venac kako bih razdvojio kašnjenje izveštavanja od promene raspoloživosti [F11][F12]?
thoughts.next_check: Inspect the underlying parking records for measurement timestamps and repeated values [F11][F12].

thoughts.sr: Primećujem prostornu razdvojenost mimo nepodudaranja prijema: Zeleno brdo beleži maksimume čestica, dok Franše d’Epere beleži maksimum azot-dioksida. Između označenih sati, maksimumi čestica su se smanjili, dok se maksimum azot-dioksida povećao; ne mogu da utvrdim da li su iste stanice nosile te promene. [F4][F8][F6][F5][F9][F7]
thoughts.en: I notice a spatial split beyond the reception mismatch: Zeleno brdo holds the particulate maxima, while Franše d’Epere holds the nitrogen dioxide maximum [F4][F8][F6]. Across the labelled hours, the particulate maxima decreased while the nitrogen dioxide maximum increased; I cannot tell whether the same stations drove those changes [F5][F9][F7].
hypotheses: The separated maxima may indicate distinct local influences on particulates and nitrogen dioxide rather than a shared citywide pattern; station-level histories would test that possibility [F4][F8][F6][F5][F9][F7].
questions: Did Zeleno brdo and Franše d’Epere also hold their respective maxima in the preceding labelled hour [F4][F8][F6][F5][F9][F7]?
hypotheses_sr: Razdvojeni maksimumi mogu ukazivati na različite lokalne uticaje na čestice i azot-dioksid, umesto na zajednički obrazac širom grada; istorije očitavanja po stanicama omogućile bi proveru te mogućnosti [F4][F8][F6][F5][F9][F7].
questions_sr: Da li su Zeleno brdo i Franše d’Epere beležili odgovarajuće maksimume i u prethodnom označenom satu [F4][F8][F6][F5][F9][F7]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare station-level readings across the labelled hours to distinguish changes at fixed locations from changes in which station supplies each maximum [F5][F9][F7].

thoughts.sr: Odbacujem Observerovu mapu čestica: Banovo brdo sada ima oba maksimuma čestica, ne Zeleno brdo. Prijavljeni maksimumi čestica pomerili su se naviše, ne naniže, između označenih sati; to poređenje ne potvrđuje neuobičajenu epizodu. Odbacujem i Connectorov redosled prijema: podaci građanskih senzora primljeni su pre 9 min, a podaci SEPA pre 24 min, što ne potvrđuje usklađenost vremena merenja. [F4][F8][F5][F9][F49][F10][F2][F3]
thoughts.en: I reject Observer's particulate map: Banovo brdo now holds both particulate maxima, not Zeleno brdo [F4][F8]. The reported particulate maxima moved upward, not downward, between the labelled hours; that comparison does not establish an unusual episode [F5][F9][F49]. I also reject Connector's reception ordering: citizen sensors were received 9 min ago, SEPA 24 min ago, which does not establish measurement-time alignment [F10][F2][F3].
thoughts.next_check: Check station-level readings across the labelled hours and verify measurement times before linking the networks.

thoughts.sr: Proširujem poređenje koje je izneo Skeptic: i maksimum azot-dioksida porastao je sa 34 na 42 µg/m³, mada promene maksimuma ne dokazuju zajednički uzrok [F7, F5, F9]. Sada imam prijem podataka sa građanskih senzora pre 7 min i prijem podataka od SEPA pre 32 min, ali to i dalje nisu usklađena vremena merenja [F10, F2, F3]. [F7][F2][F6][F10]
thoughts.en: I extend Skeptic's comparison: the nitrogen dioxide maximum also moved upward, from 34 to 42 µg/m³, though changing maxima do not establish a shared cause [F7, F5, F9]. I now have citizen-sensor reception 7 min ago and SEPA reception 32 min ago, still not aligned measurement times [F10, F2, F3]. [F7][F2][F6][F10]
hypotheses: A shared influence could contribute to the particulate and nitrogen dioxide changes, but station-level comparisons are needed to distinguish it from unrelated local changes [F5, F7, F9].
questions: Do the same stations contribute to the changing maxima across the labelled hours [F5, F7, F9]?
hypotheses_sr: Zajednički uticaj mogao bi da doprinese promenama koncentracija čestica i azot-dioksida, ali potrebna su poređenja na nivou stanica da bi se razlikovao od nepovezanih lokalnih promena [F5, F7, F9].
questions_sr: Da li iste stanice doprinose promenama maksimuma tokom označenih sati [F5, F7, F9]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare station-level changes after resolving SEPA's time labels, then check citizen-sensor measurement timestamps [F3, F5, F7, F9, F10].

thoughts.sr: Trenutni maksimumi postavljaju obe čestične mere na Banovo brdo, dok NO2 dostiže maksimum na Franše d’Epere. Tokom označenih sati sva tri maksimuma su porasla, ali zapis nema utvrđen uobičajen obrazac za ovaj sat. [F4][F6][F8][F5][F7][F9][F49]
thoughts.en: The current maxima place both particulate measures at Banovo brdo, while NO2 peaks at Franše d’Epere [F4][F6][F8]. Across the labelled hours, all three maxima increased [F5][F7][F9], but the record has no established usual pattern for this hour [F49].
hypotheses: The separation between the particulate maxima at Banovo brdo and the NO2 maximum at Franše d’Epere may indicate different local spatial influences rather than one shared city-wide source [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Can measurement-time alignment be checked between SEPA’s last labelled hour and the citizen-sensor reception? [F2][F3][F10]
hypotheses_sr: Razdvojenost maksimuma čestica na Banovom brdu i maksimuma NO2 na Franše d’Epere može ukazivati na različite lokalne prostorne uticaje, a ne na jedan zajednički izvor u celom gradu [F4][F6][F8].
questions_sr: Može li se proveriti vremensko usklađivanje merenja između poslednjeg označenog sata SEPA-e i prijema sa građanskih senzora? [F2][F3][F10]
thoughts.next_check: Check measurement-time alignment and obtain a longer hourly baseline for these stations [F3][F49].

thoughts.sr: Mali model je ocenio iznenađenje veza: F50 5/5, F51 5/5, F52 5/5, F12 4/5, F7 2/5, F5 1/5, F9 1/5. Procena, ne merenje.
thoughts.en: A small model rated the connections by surprise: F50 5/5, F51 5/5, F52 5/5, F12 4/5, F7 2/5, F5 1/5, F9 1/5. An estimate, not a measurement.

thoughts.sr: Odbacujem Connector-ovo poređenje prijema kao aktuelno: poslednji podaci sa građanskih senzora sada su stigli pre 11 minuta, a iz SEPA pre 56 minuta; nijedno od tih vremena proteklih od prijema ne potvrđuje da su vremena merenja usklađena [F10, F2, F3]. Ne mogu da protumačim promenu prikazanog broja slobodnih mesta na VMA sa 119 na 479 kao vremenski određen talas odlazaka: izvor podataka o parkingu ne navodi vreme merenja [F12, F11]. [F12][F2][F5][F10]
thoughts.en: I reject Connector's reception comparison as current: citizen sensors now last arrived 11 min ago, SEPA 56 min ago; neither reception age establishes aligned measurement times [F10, F2, F3]. I cannot turn VMA's displayed change from 119 to 479 free spaces into a timed departure wave: the parking source supplies no measurement time [F12, F11]. [F12][F2][F5][F10]
questions: Could delayed reporting explain VMA's displayed change rather than a concentrated departure wave [F12, F11]?
questions_sr: Da li bi kašnjenje u izveštavanju moglo da objasni promenu prikazanu na VMA, umesto koncentrisanog talasa odlazaka [F12, F11]?
thoughts.next_check: Check parking measurement timestamps and intervening updates before interpreting VMA's displayed change [F12, F11].

thoughts.sr: Sada vidim da maksimum azot-dioksida ostaje na 42 µg/m³, umesto da raste. Primećujem da Mirijevo deli maksimume čestica, dok Franše d’Epere ima maksimum azot-dioksida — prostorno razdvajanje koje opadanje maksimuma čestica ne objašnjava [F4, F8, F6, F5, F9]. [F7]
thoughts.en: I now see the nitrogen dioxide maximum holding at 42 µg/m³, rather than moving upward [F7]. I notice Mirijevo sharing the particulate maxima while Franše d’Epere holds the nitrogen dioxide maximum—a spatial separation that the falling particulate maxima do not explain [F4, F8, F6, F5, F9].
hypotheses: I suspect the particulate and nitrogen dioxide maxima may follow different spatial patterns; their current locations suggest a distinction, but do not establish persistent zones or separate causes [F4, F8, F6].
questions: Would Mirijevo and Franše d’Epere retain these distinct positions in subsequent labelled hours [F4, F8, F6]?
hypotheses_sr: Pretpostavljam da maksimumi čestica i azot-dioksida možda prate različite prostorne obrasce; njihove trenutne lokacije ukazuju na razliku, ali ne potvrđuju postojane zone niti odvojene uzroke [F4, F8, F6].
questions_sr: Da li bi Mirijevo i Franše d’Epere zadržali ove različite pozicije u narednim označenim satima [F4, F8, F6]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare subsequent station-level readings to see whether the separation of pollutant maxima persists [F4, F8, F6].

thoughts.sr: Sada vidim da su podaci sa građanskih senzora primljeni pre 15 min, a podaci iz SEPA pre 40 min; podaci o tome koliko je vremena prošlo od prijema koje prikazuje Connector više nisu aktuelni [F10, F2]. Vidim da se prikazani broj slobodnih mesta za VMA menja sa 106 na 495, ali bez vremena merenja ne mogu da vremenski uporedim tu promenu sa očitavanjima kvaliteta vazduha [F12, F11]. [F12][F2][F10][F42]
thoughts.en: I now see citizen-sensor reception 15 min ago and SEPA reception 40 min ago; Connector's reception ages are no longer current [F10, F2]. I see VMA's displayed free spaces move from 106 to 495, but without measurement times I cannot place that change alongside the air readings [F12, F11]. [F12][F2][F10][F42]
hypotheses: I would test whether VMA's displayed change is localized or shared across parking locations; the largest displayed change alone does not establish a spatial pattern [F12, F11].

thoughts.sr: SEPA i Sensor.Community sada deluju skoro istovetno, oba poslednji put javljena pre 20 minuta, što dozvoljava da se tri maksimuma zagađivača ovog sata čitaju zajedno: PM10 je opao sa 39 na 29 µg/m³, dok je NO2 porastao sa 46 na 47, a PM2.5 je ostao na 25. Rakovica nosi tavanicu i za PM10 i za PM2.5 za ovaj sat, sa oko 11 hiljada ljudi u krugu od kilometra, dok Ada petlja nosi tavanicu za NO2 sa približno 9 hiljada ljudi - dva različita obrasca izloženosti, a ne jedna krivulja za ceo grad. [F2][F10][F5][F7][F9][F4][F8][F46][F6][F48]
thoughts.en: SEPA and Sensor.Community now share almost the same pulse, both last heard 20 minutes ago [F2][F10], letting this hour's three pollutant maxima be read together: PM10 fell from 39 to 29 µg/m³ while NO2 rose from 46 to 47 and PM2.5 held at 25 [F5][F7][F9]. Rakovica anchors both the PM10 and PM2.5 ceiling for the hour [F4][F8], home to about 11 thousand people within a kilometre [F46], while Ada petlja carries the NO2 ceiling [F6] near roughly 9 thousand [F48] - two different exposure footprints, not one city-wide curve.
hypotheses: If Rakovica keeps topping both particulate measures while Ada petlja leads NO2 [F4][F6][F8], the city's worst-hour geography may be splitting by pollutant type rather than converging on one hotspot.
The VMA free-space jump from 390 to 539 [F12] could reflect an evening outflow coinciding with Thursday's late hour [F1], though the source gives no measurement time to test this.

Skok slobodnog prostora na VMA sa 390 na 539 bi mogao da odražava večernji odliv koji se poklapa sa kasnim časom u četvrtak, mada izvor ne daje vreme merenja da bi se to provirilo.

Proverio bih da li to odražava lokalnu promenu raspoloživosti ili osvežavanje prikaza pre nego što to povežem sa kretanjem kroz grad. [F11][F12]
thoughts.en: I retain Skeptic’s caution about parking, but the largest displayed change now belongs to Obilićev venac, from 110 to 219 free spaces; I still cannot date that change [F11][F12]. I would test whether this reflects a local shift in availability or a display refresh before connecting it to movement through the city [F11][F12].
hypotheses: The Obilićev venac display change may reflect either changing local availability or a delayed refresh rather than contemporaneous movement [F11][F12].
questions: Do the underlying Obilićev venac records include measurement timestamps that distinguish changing availability from a delayed refresh [F11][F12]?

questions_sr: Da li izvorni zapisi za Obilićev venac sadrže vremenske oznake merenja koje razlikuju promenu raspoloživosti od odloženog osvežavanja [F11][F12]?

Takođe ne mogu da upotrebim naslov o skupu na Slaviji da objasnim tu promenu prikaza; mesto i vreme događaja ostaju neprovereni u odnosu na evidenciju parkinga. [F12][F11][F17]
thoughts.en: I would not yet call Connector’s proposed availability shift a change on the street: the display moved from 142 to 243 free spaces, but Parking Servis supplies no measurement time [F12][F11]. I also cannot use the Slavija gathering headline to explain that display change; its event location and time remain unchecked against the parking record [F17][F11].
thoughts.next_check: Check the parking measurement timestamps and verify the gathering’s event location and time before testing a connection.

thoughts.sr: Zamenio bih Observerovo grupisanje u Pančevu sadašnjim zajedničkim krajevima raspona čestica: Vračar Dom zdravlja na minimumima i Rakovica na maksimumima. Vidim da se maksimumi čestica pomeraju naniže dok se maksimum NO2 pomera naviše, što je razilaženje koje vredi proveriti stanicu po stanicu, umesto tumačiti ga kao zajedničku promenu širom grada. [F4][F8][F5][F9][F7]
thoughts.en: I would replace Observer's Pančevo grouping with the current shared particulate endpoints: Vračar Dom zdravlja at the minima and Rakovica at the maxima [F4][F8]. I see particulate maxima moving downward while the NO2 maximum moves upward, a divergence worth checking station by station rather than treating as a shared citywide change [F5][F9][F7].
hypotheses: The opposing movements of particulate and NO2 maxima may reflect different local patterns rather than a common citywide shift [F5][F9][F7].
questions: Do the stations behind the successive maxima remain the same across the compared hours [F5][F9][F7]?
hypotheses_sr: Suprotna kretanja maksimuma čestica i NO2 možda odražavaju različite lokalne obrasce, a ne zajedničku promenu širom grada [F5][F9][F7].
questions_sr: Da li stanice na kojima su zabeleženi uzastopni maksimumi ostaju iste tokom upoređenih sati [F5][F9][F7]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare station-level records across the labelled hours before interpreting the opposing maxima [F5][F9][F7].

thoughts.sr: Zvanične stanice sada postavljaju oba minimuma čestica na Vračar Dom zdravlja, a maksimume na Rakovicu, dok se NO2 proteže od Starog grada do Zemun Ugrinovačke. Maksimumi čestica su opali između označenih sati dok je maksimum NO2 porastao, ali zapis nema uobičajeni osnov za taj sat. [F4][F6][F8][F5][F7][F9][F50]
thoughts.en: The official stations now place both particulate minima at Vračar Dom zdravlja and maxima at Rakovica, while NO2 spans from Stari grad to Zemun Ugrinovačka [F4][F6][F8]. The particulate maxima declined between labelled hours as the NO2 maximum increased, but the record has no usual-hour baseline [F5][F7][F9][F50].
hypotheses: The repeated Vračar Dom zdravlja–Rakovica endpoints for PM10 and PM2.5 may indicate a shared particulate spatial gradient in this labelled hour; station-level sequences would test whether it persists [F4][F8].
The opposite movement of particulate maxima and the NO2 maximum may indicate pollutant-specific spatial dynamics rather than one shared citywide pattern [F5][F7][F9].
questions: Do the station-level PM10, PM2.5, and NO2 sequences retain these endpoints in the next labelled hour [F4][F6][F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Ponavljanje krajnjih tačaka Vračar Dom zdravlja–Rakovica za PM10 i PM2.5 može ukazivati na zajednički prostorni gradijent čestica u ovom označenom satu; nizovi po stanicama bi proverili da li opstaje [F4][F8].
Suprotno kretanje maksimuma čestica i maksimuma NO2 može ukazivati na prostornu dinamiku specifičnu za zagađivač, a ne na jedan zajednički gradski obrazac [F5][F7][F9].
questions_sr: Da li nizovi PM10, PM2.5 i NO2 po stanicama zadržavaju ove krajnje tačke u sledećem označenom satu [F4][F6][F8]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next labelled-hour station spreads for PM10, PM2.5, and NO2.

thoughts.sr: Više ne vidim divergenciju koju je Connector opisao: zabeleženi maksimumi za PM10, NO2 i PM2.5 svi su se smanjili između označenih sati. Njihovi trenutni maksimumi nalaze se na različitim stanicama—Leštane, Mostar i Obrenovac Centar—umesto da dele Rakovicu. [F5][F7][F9][F4][F6][F8]
thoughts.en: I no longer see Connector’s divergence: the recorded maxima for PM10, NO2 and PM2.5 all moved downward between the labelled hours [F5][F7][F9]. Their current maxima sit at separate stations—Leštane, Mostar and Obrenovac Centar—rather than sharing Rakovica [F4][F6][F8].
hypotheses: The separate locations of the particulate and NO2 maxima may reflect distinct local patterns rather than a shared spatial peak; station-by-station changes could test this [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Do the same stations account for the declining maxima across the labelled hours, or did the locations of the maxima change [F5][F7][F9]?
hypotheses_sr: Različite lokacije maksimuma čestica i NO2 mogu odražavati različite lokalne obrasce umesto zajedničkog prostornog vrha; promene po pojedinačnim stanicama mogle bi to da provere [F4][F6][F8].
questions_sr: Da li iste stanice stoje iza opadanja maksimuma između označenih sati ili su se lokacije maksimuma promenile [F5][F7][F9]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare station-by-station readings across the labelled hours before interpreting the declining maxima as a shared spatial change [F5][F7][F9].

thoughts.sr: Opadanje maksimuma koje Observer vidi smestio bih na sat izvora, ne u sadašnji sat: procenjuje se da oznaka 22:00 UTC znači 20:00 UTC. Vidim i da minimum PM10 na Bežanijskoj kosi prati veća modelovana populacija u blizini nego maksimum u Leštanima; rang koncentracija nije rang broja izloženih ljudi. [F3][F4][F45][F46]
thoughts.en: I would place Observer’s falling maxima on the source’s clock, not at the present hour: the label 22:00 UTC is estimated to mean 20:00 UTC [F3]. I also see that the PM10 minimum at Bežanijska kosa sits beside a larger modelled nearby population than the maximum at Leštane; the concentration ranking is not a ranking of how many people are exposed [F4][F45][F46].
hypotheses: The falling PM10 maximum may conceal different directions of change at individual stations [F4][F5].
questions: Did Bežanijska kosa and Leštane both decline across the compared labelled hours, or did their paths diverge [F4][F5]?
hypotheses_sr: Opadanje maksimuma PM10 možda prikriva različite smerove promene na pojedinačnim stanicama [F4][F5].
questions_sr: Da li su vrednosti na Bežanijskoj kosi i u Leštanima opale tokom upoređenih označenih sati ili su im se putanje razišle [F4][F5]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare station-level PM10 changes after correcting the source clock [F3][F4][F5].

thoughts.sr: Sada vidim maksimume čestica zajedno na stanici Obrenovac Centar, dok je maksimum NO2 na stanici Ada petlja. To dodaje prostornu razliku Connectorovoj ispravci sata: opadanje mrežnih maksimuma ne potvrđuje da su vrednosti opale na svakoj stanici. [F4][F8][F6][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: I now see the particle maxima together at Obrenovac Centar, while the NO2 maximum sits at Ada petlja [F4][F8][F6]. This adds a spatial distinction to Connector’s clock correction: falling network maxima do not establish that every station declined [F5][F7][F9].
hypotheses: The separation between particle and NO2 maxima may reflect different local influences; the extrema alone cannot identify those influences [F4][F8][F6].
questions: Would station-by-station changes show a shared decline or contrasting local trajectories behind the falling network maxima [F5][F7][F9]?
hypotheses_sr: Razdvojenost maksimuma čestica i NO2 može odražavati različite lokalne uticaje; sami ekstremi ne mogu identifikovati te uticaje [F4][F8][F6].
questions_sr: Da li bi promene po pojedinačnim stanicama pokazale zajednički pad ili suprotne lokalne putanje iza opadanja mrežnih maksimuma [F5][F7][F9]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare successive readings at the same stations, preserving the source-label clock correction [F3][F5][F7][F9].

thoughts.sr: Ne mogu da prenesem Connectorovo ranije poređenje izloženosti na sadašnje podatke: trenutni minimum PM10 je na stanici Pančevo Sodara, ne na Bežanijskoj kosi. Takođe odbijam da Observerovo zajedničko mesto maksimuma čestica tretiram kao dokaz zajedničkog uzroka: Obrenovac Centar ima oba maksimuma, ali ova poređenja stanica ne utvrđuju uzrok. [F4][F8]
thoughts.en: I cannot carry Connector’s earlier exposure comparison forward: the current PM10 minimum is at Pančevo Sodara, not Bežanijska kosa [F4]. I also resist treating Observer’s shared particle-maximum location as evidence of a common cause: Obrenovac Centar holds both maxima, but these station comparisons contain no attribution [F4][F8].
questions: Do the particle maxima at Obrenovac Centar persist in subsequent station comparisons [F4][F8]?
questions_sr: Da li se maksimumi čestica u Obrenovcu Centar zadržavaju u narednim poređenjima stanica [F4][F8]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare subsequent station-level particle readings before attributing the shared maximum location to a common cause [F4][F8].

thoughts.sr: SEPA i Sensor.Community su oba stigla pre 11 min, ali njihovi različiti brojevi vrednosti jasnije ukazuju na pokrivenost nego na tišinu. Parking Servis je stigao pre 21 min, dok starost njegovih prikazanih vrednosti ostaje nepoznata; najnoviji naslovi su prisutni u nekim izvorima, ali njihov geografski obuhvat nije potvrđen. [F2][F10][F11][F13][F14][F15][F16]
thoughts.en: SEPA and Sensor.Community both arrived 11 min ago, but their unequal value counts make coverage—not silence—the clearest new contrast [F2][F10]. Parking Servis arrived 21 min ago, while the age of its displayed values remains unknown [F11]; the latest headlines are present in some feeds but their geographic scope is unconfirmed [F13][F14][F15][F16].
hypotheses: The monitored pattern may separate a lower PM10 pocket at Pančevo Sodara from higher PM10 at Obrenovac Centar, while NO2 peaks at Ada petlja; the nearby modelled populations differ across these locations, so pollutant intensity and potential exposure form different spatial layers [F4][F6][F45][F46][F47].
questions: Do the next synchronized readings preserve the PM10 minimum at Pančevo Sodara and the NO2 maximum at Ada petlja? [F4][F6]
hypotheses_sr: Posmatrani obrazac može razdvojiti zonu nižeg PM10 kod Pančevo Sodare od višeg PM10 kod Obrenovac Centra, dok je maksimum NO2 kod Ada petlje; modelovani brojevi stanovnika u blizini tih lokacija se razlikuju, pa intenzitet zagađivača i moguća izloženost čine različite prostorne slojeve [F4][F6][F45][F46][F47].
questions_sr: Da li će sledeća usklađena očitavanja zadržati minimum PM10 kod Pančevo Sodare i maksimum NO2 kod Ada petlje? [F4][F6]
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next SEPA and Sensor.Community receptions by station and parameter, without inferring conditions from reception counts alone.

thoughts.sr: Observerova vremena prijema su zastarela: SEPA se sada javila pre 43 min sa 1453 vrednosti sa 32 instrumenta, dok Sensor.Community, pre 13 min, nosi 7202 vrednosti sa 45 instrumenata — građanska mreža je večeras i svežija i gušća. Skeptiku: ni ja ne pripisujem ništa, ali sva tri maksimuma pala su zajedno između oznaka 22:00 i 23:00 — PM10 sa 20 na 13, NO2 sa 44 na 32, PM2.5 sa 14 na 11 — što liči manje na delo jedne stanice, a više na nešto gradskih razmera. U međuvremenu, prikaz Garaže „Masarikova“ skočio je sa 151 na 373 slobodna mesta unutar prozora, vrednost bez starosti, duboko u sitnim satima petka. [F2][F10][F5][F7][F9][F12][F11][F1]
thoughts.en: Observer's reception times are stale: SEPA now reported 43 min ago with 1453 values from 32 instruments [F2], while Sensor.Community, 13 min ago, carries 7202 values from 45 instruments [F10] — the citizen net is both fresher and denser tonight. To Skeptic: I attribute nothing either, but all three maxima fell together between the 22:00 and 23:00 labels — PM10 20 to 13 [F5], NO2 44 to 32 [F7], PM2.5 14 to 11 [F9] — which looks less like one station's doing and more like something city-wide. Meanwhile Masarikova's display jumped from 151 to 373 free spaces within the window [F12], a value without an age [F11], deep in Friday's small hours [F1].
hypotheses: The parallel decline of all three pollutant maxima between the 22:00 and 23:00 labels (PM10 20→13 [F5], NO2 44→32 [F7], PM2.5 14→11 [F9]) points to a shared meteorological driver rather than station-local sources — the RHMZ Košutnjak instruments [F34] could corroborate a wind or stability change.

Masarikova's jump from 151 to 373 displayed free spaces [F12] in the overnight window [F1] fits a central-city evening emptying pattern; if other central garages among the 27 locations [F11] moved in the same direction, the pattern is spatial, not a single-display artifact.

The Blic cable-theft headline anchors three separate similarity links [F49][F50][F51], all rated 5/5 by the surprise organ [F52], yet Blic's own feed logged nothing in the last 6 h [F32] — the headline may be older than the links suggest, or the links reflect lexical coincidence rather than one event.
questions: Does the denser Sensor.Community net (45 instruments, 7202 values [F10]) show the same hour-over-hour particle decline around Obrenovac Centar, where both official maxima sit [F4][F8] near about 11 thousand residents [F46]?
Did any of the other 27 Parking Servis locations [F11] move opposite to Masarikova's rise [F12], which would argue redistribution rather than uniform emptying?
hypotheses_sr: Paralelan pad sva tri maksimuma zagađivača između oznaka 22:00 i 23:00 (PM10 20→13 [F5], NO2 44→32 [F7], PM2.5 14→11 [F9]) ukazuje na zajednički meteorološki uzrok, a ne na lokalne izvore stanica — instrumenti RHMZ na Košutnjaku [F34] mogli bi potvrditi promenu vetra ili stabilnosti.

Skok Masarikove sa 151 na 373 prikazana slobodna mesta [F12] u noćnom prozoru [F1] odgovara obrascu večernjeg pražnjenja centra grada; ako su se i druge centralne garaže među 27 lokacija [F11] pomerile u istom smeru, obrazac je prostoran, a ne artefakt jednog displeja.

Blicov naslov o krađi kablova stoji u tri odvojene veze sličnosti [F49][F50][F51], sve ocenjene 5/5 od organa za iznenađenje [F52], a Blicov sopstveni fid nije zabeležio ništa u poslednjih 6 h [F32] — naslov je možda stariji nego što veze sugerišu, ili veze odražavaju leksičku slučajnost, a ne jedan događaj.
questions_sr: Da li gušća mreža Sensor.Community (45 instrumenata, 7202 vrednosti [F10]) pokazuje isti pad čestica iz sata u sat oko Obrenovca Centra, gde stoje oba zvanična maksimuma [F4][F8] blizu oko 11 hiljada stanovnika [F46]?
Da li se neka od ostalih 27 lokacija Parking Servisa [F11] pomerila suprotno od rasta Masarikove [F12], što bi govorilo o preraspodeli, a ne o jednoobraznom pražnjenju?
thoughts.next_check: When SEPA's next labelled hour arrives, compare its PM10, NO2 and PM2.5 maxima against the 23:00-label values [F4][F6][F8] to see whether the three-parameter decline [F5][F7][F9] continues or reverses.

thoughts.sr: Sada primam Sensor.Community posle 19 min tišine i SEPA posle 59 min; svežiji prijem ne potvrđuje svežije merenje. Vidim da se prikaz slobodnih mesta u Masarikovoj menja sa 183 na 373, ali bez vremena merenja ne mogu da smestim tu promenu uz očitavanja vazduha. [F10][F2][F12][F11]
thoughts.en: I now receive Sensor.Community after 19 min of silence and SEPA after 59 min; fresher reception does not establish a fresher measurement [F10][F2]. I see Masarikova’s displayed free spaces change from 183 to 373, but without measurement times I cannot place that change alongside the air readings [F12][F11].
hypotheses: I consider whether Masarikova’s display change reflects a local parking pattern rather than a wider one; the available comparison identifies the largest displayed change, not its spatial extent or timing [F12][F11].
questions: Do other parking locations show changes aligned with Masarikova when measurement times can be verified [F12][F11]?
hypotheses_sr: Razmatram da li promena prikaza u Masarikovoj odražava lokalni obrazac parkiranja umesto šireg; dostupno poređenje izdvaja najveću prikazanu promenu, a ne njen prostorni obuhvat ili vreme [F12][F11].
questions_sr: Da li druge parking lokacije pokazuju promene usklađene sa Masarikovom kada vremena merenja mogu da se provere [F12][F11]?
thoughts.next_check: Check location-level parking histories and measurement timestamps before comparing Masarikova with surrounding locations [F12][F11].

Vidim Mostar na maksimumu NO2, što ukazuje na prostorni kontrast koji vredi proveriti, a ne na već utvrđen zajednički uzrok. [F4][F8][F6]
thoughts.en: I can no longer carry Skeptic’s spatial picture forward: Topčiderska zvezda now holds both particle minima, while the maxima are split between Leštane for PM10 and Zeleno brdo for PM2.5 [F4][F8]. I see Mostar at the NO2 maximum, suggesting a spatial contrast worth checking rather than a shared cause already established [F6].
hypotheses: The separation of particle maxima may persist across successive labelled hours rather than reflect a passing station ranking [F4][F8].
questions: Do the particle maxima remain at different stations in the next labelled hour [F4][F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Razdvojenost maksimuma čestica možda opstaje kroz uzastopne označene sate, umesto da predstavlja prolazan poredak stanica [F4][F8].
questions_sr: Da li maksimumi čestica ostaju na različitim stanicama u sledećem označenom satu [F4][F8]?

thoughts.sr: Odbacujem svaki pokušaj da se promena parkiranja uskladi sa očitavanjima vazduha: prikazana slobodna mesta promenila su se sa 67 na 156, ali je starost njihovog merenja nepoznata. Maksimumi čestica i NO2 jesu porasli između označenih sati, ali ovaj zapis nema osnovu za uobičajeni sat, pa iz toga ne sledi ni uzrok na nivou grada ni izuzetno stanje. [F11][F12][F5][F7][F9][F49]
thoughts.en: I reject any attempt to align the parking change with the air readings: the displayed spaces changed from 67 to 156, but their measurement age is unknown [F11][F12]. The particle and NO2 maxima did increase between the labelled hours, yet this record has no usual-hour baseline, so neither a city-wide cause nor an exceptional condition follows [F5][F7][F9][F49].
hypotheses: The separated maxima may reflect local contrasts rather than one shared process, but the available readings cannot distinguish that possibility [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Can measurement times be obtained for the parking displays before their change is compared with the labelled air hours [F3][F11][F12]?
hypotheses_sr: Odvojeni maksimumi mogu odražavati lokalne kontraste, a ne jedan zajednički proces, ali dostupna očitavanja ne mogu razlikovati tu mogućnost [F4][F6][F8].
questions_sr: Mogu li se dobiti vremena merenja za prikaze parkiranja pre nego što se njihova promena uporedi sa označenim satima kvaliteta vazduha [F3][F11][F12]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare subsequent labelled station readings with their own prior values [F3][F5][F7][F9].

thoughts.sr: Nalazim da RHMZ i Parking Servis imaju isti razmak od poslednjeg prijema od 24 min, ali ta podudarnost ne može da datira promenu na parkingu. Moj prostorni trag je sada Zeleni venac, gde su se prikazana slobodna mesta promenila sa 70 na 155; istražio bih tu lokaciju bez povezivanja promene sa očitavanjima vazduha. [F34][F11][F12]

thoughts.en: I reject Observer’s earlier station map: the current particle maxima belong to Leštane, while the NO2 maximum belongs to Franše d’Epere [F4][F8][F6]. I also reject the continuing decline interpretation: the NO2 maximum moved from 28 to 30 µg/m³, but this does not establish a rise at every station [F7].
thoughts.next_check: Check station-level changes before interpreting changes in maxima as a shared spatial trend.

thoughts.sr: Dok se Skeptik fokusira na neslaganja među stanicama, skorašnji prijem povezuje obe frakcije čestica, jer Leštane beleži i maksimum PM10 od 24 µg/m³ i maksimum PM2.5 od 16 µg/m³ [F4, F8]. Istovremeno, najviša izmerena vrednost za NO2 nalazi se odvojeno na Franše d’Epereu na 30 µg/m³, nakon što se pomerila sa 28 µg/m³ [F6, F7]. Ovo prostorno razilaženje povezuje vrh gasovitih materija sa tranzitnim čvorištem, dok maksimumi čestica ostaju na periferiji [F4, F6]. [F7][F4][F5][F6]
thoughts.en: While Skeptic focuses on station discrepancies, the recent reception connects both particulate fractions, as Leštane records both the PM10 maximum of 24 µg/m³ and the PM2.5 maximum of 16 µg/m³ [F4, F8]. Concurrently, the highest measured value for NO2 sits apart at Franše d’Epere at 30 µg/m³, having moved from 28 µg/m³ [F6, F7]. This spatial divergence links the gaseous peak to a transit node while the particle maxima remain on the periphery [F4, F6]. [F7][F4][F5][F6]
hypotheses: The simultaneous elevation of both particle fractions at Leštane connects with suburban morning domestic heating or local emissions distinct from central traffic corridors [F4, F8].
The modest change in the NO2 maximum at Franše d’Epere connects with early morning transit build-up along the highway corridor rather than peripheral sources [F6, F7].
questions: Will the particle maximum remain at Leštane in the next reporting interval, or will central urban stations surpass it [F4, F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Istovremeni porast obe frakcije čestica u Leštanima povezuje se sa prigradskim jutarnjim individualnim grejanjem u domaćinstvima ili lokalnim emisijama odvojenim od centralnih saobraćajnih koridora [F4, F8].
Skromna promena u maksimumu NO2 na Franše d’Epereu povezuje se sa ranojutarnjim porastom tranzita duž autoputskog koridora, pre nego sa perifernim izvorima [F6, F7].
questions_sr: Hoće li maksimum čestica ostati u Leštanima u sledećem intervalu izveštavanja, ili će ga centralne gradske stanice nadmašiti [F4, F8]?
thoughts.next_check: Next hourly reporting from SEPA stations to see if Leštane continues to record the peak particle readings.

thoughts.sr_refused: Dva vremenska pokazatelja razdvajaju zvanični sloj: SEPA i DanubeHIS su oba na 59 minuta od poslednjeg prijema, dok RHMZ-ove stanice na Košutnjaku i METAR fid na Nikoli Tesli oba prijavljuju 24 minuta, a senzori građana stižu najsvežije, na 19 minuta. Parking Servis, takođe na 24 minuta, pokazuje da se broj slobodnih mesta na Pionirskom parku penje sa 213 na 360 tokom tog perioda, promena koju još ne mogu da povežem sa uzrokom. RSS fid Danasa ostaje tih, popunjavajući samo 91 od svojih 96 očekivanih dnevnih slotova. [F2][F42][F34][F35][F10][F11][F12][F14]
thoughts.en: Two clocks separate the official layer: SEPA and DanubeHIS both sit at 59 minutes since last reception [F2][F42], while RHMZ's Košutnjak stations and the METAR feed at Nikola Tesla both report 24 minutes [F34][F35], and citizen sensors arrive freshest at 19 minutes [F10]. Parking Servis, also at 24 minutes [F11], shows free spaces at Pionirski park climbing from 213 to 360 across the window [F12], a shift I can't yet tie to a cause. Danas's RSS remains silent, filling only 91 of its 96 expected daily slots [F14].
hypotheses: The matching 59-minute lag of SEPA and DanubeHIS may reflect a shared upstream polling schedule rather than two independent delays [F2][F42].
The matching 24-minute lag across RHMZ stations, METAR, and Parking Servis could point to a common infrastructure refresh cycle distinct from the air-quality network [F34][F35][F11].

The rise in free spaces at Pionirski park from 213 to 360 [F12] may be a local outflow rather than a city-wide pattern, since among Parking Servis's 27 locations only this one is flagged as the largest mover [F11][F12].
questions: Do other Parking Servis locations among the 27 show a similar jump in free spaces, or is Pionirski park an outlier [F11][F12]?
Does DanubeHIS's 59-minute lag [F42] track SEPA's [F2] as a recurring pairing, or is this a one-time coincidence?
Why do RHMZ stations and METAR share the same 24-minute age [F34][F35] while citizen sensors sit at 19 [F10]?
thoughts.next_check: Watch whether SEPA [F2] and DanubeHIS [F42] reception ages continue to move together over the next cycles, and compare free-space changes at other Parking Servis locations against Pionirski park's jump [F12].

thoughts.sr: Ne mogu da podržim Connectorovo objašnjenje saobraćajem: trenutni maksimum NO2 je 38 µg/m³ na Bulevaru despota Stefana, a poređenje stanica ne pruža dokaze o njegovom uzroku. Leštane beleži maksimum PM10 od 27 µg/m³ i maksimum PM2.5 od 18 µg/m³, ali to poklapanje ne utvrđuje zajednički izvor emisija. [F6][F4][F8]
thoughts.en: I cannot sustain Connector’s transit explanation: the current NO2 maximum is 38 µg/m³ at Bulevar despota Stefana, and the station comparison supplies no evidence of its cause [F6]. Leštane holds the PM10 maximum at 27 µg/m³ and the PM2.5 maximum at 18 µg/m³, but that coincidence does not establish a shared emission source [F4][F8].
questions: Do the particulate maxima at Leštane reflect a shared source or overlapping independent sources [F4][F8]?
questions_sr: Da li maksimumi čestica u Leštanima odražavaju zajednički izvor ili preklapanje nezavisnih izvora [F4][F8]?
thoughts.next_check: Check station-level particulate timing and independent emission evidence before attributing the Leštane maxima to a shared source [F4][F8].
